name: BAW 2352 询问两地天气 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 352, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over X-Ray India Alpha, squawking 3567, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Speedbird 352，保持 11000 米，飞越 X-Ray India Alpha，应答机 3567，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, maintaining 11000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，保持 11000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, Wuhan Control, descend to 9200 meters, reduced speed to 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，武汉管制，下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to 270 knots until advised, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed there was a cumulonimbus ahead, contact Wuhan Control and request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，联系武汉管制，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，前方有 CB，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB, ask Wuhan Control to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离 CB，请求武汉管制恢复航路飞行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW2352, clear of CB, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW2352，已脱离 CB，请求恢复航路。

cards.audioText: B: You have received the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, ask Wuhan Approach if your alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已收到最新 ATIS，显示武汉能见度低，询问武汉进近备降场合肥是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW2352, the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, is our alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW2352，最新 ATIS 显示武汉能见度低，请问我们的备降场合肥是否可用于备降？

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 352, Hefei Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Hefei?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Hefei at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 352，合肥机场可用，确认你们备降合肥吗？
B：告诉管制员目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉。
cards.referenceText: We are not diverting to Hefei now, we still want to fly to Wuhan, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, track direct to Zulu Foxtrot, follow Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，直飞 Zulu Foxtrot，执行 Zulu Foxtrot 2 Alpha 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF2A arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, established ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米、中段 600 米、末端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36 右。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 metres, cleared to land runway 36R, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36R，BAW2352。

cards.audioText: B: The weather is deteriorating and below your landing minima, you executed a missed approach, advised Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：天气正在恶化并低于你的着陆最低标准，你执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, the weather is deteriorating and below our landing minima, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，天气正在恶化并低于我们的着陆最低标准，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，执行标准复飞程序，条件允许时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, BAW2352.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Hefei Airport, informed Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在爬升至复飞高度，决定备降合肥机场，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW2352, request divert to Hefei Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW2352，请求备降合肥机场。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 352, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 352，收到，右转直飞 Lima Kilo Oscar，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, BAW2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，BAW2352。
